title: Nasty Liq Kiwi Passionfruit Guava 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid By Nasty Juice
description: Embark on a tropical journey with Nasty Liq's Kiwi Passion Fruit Guava, a Nic salt e-liquid that encapsulates the essence of an island adventure. As you inhale, the tartness of kiwi greets you, its unique tanginess setting the stage for a tropical escapade. Soon, the alluring sweetness of passion fruit sweeps in, mingling with the kiwi to produce a dance of flavours that's both invigorating and harmonious. As the voyage continues, the luscious notes of guava make their presence known, adding depth and rounding out the tropical medley with its distinctive taste. This combination brings to mind a handcrafted fruit punch, one that you might enjoy as you lounge on a beach watching the sunset. It's a supremely well-crafted blend that transports you to warmer climates with every puff. In fact, it’s nothing short of a vacation in a bottle. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the Nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape kit devices. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more delicious Nasty Liq flavours to try. Nasty Juice have fine-tuned their vape juices for optimised performance with the vast majority of MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices. They feature exceptional flavours and flavour blends across fruits, sweets, desserts and tobacco and many are also available in Nasty Juice’s super-convenient Nasty Bar disposable vape bars.
